exclusions: tracking issues #134-#139 (never close or edit them); owner-decision issues #3 (package metadata), #4 (license), #5 (third-party notices), #6 (distribution format), #10 (roadmap re-baseline); CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md (no lane edits them)

lanes.note: #33 BouncyCastle chain validation + RFC 6125 hostname matching, #34 Auto mode must fail closed (no silent permanent fallback to unvalidated BouncyCastle; h2 optional when http/1.1 is offered), and the negative TLS tests of #113 that cover them. One PR in Runtime/Transport/Tls and Runtime/Transport/BouncyCastle (never Lib/).

HPACK state integrity: always decode header blocks of closed/cancelled streams (#11), encode+write request trailers under one _writeLock hold (#12), apply SETTINGS_HEADER_TABLE_SIZE changes under the encoder's lock with minimum-size signaling (#27).

Http11ResponseParser strictness: EOF inside headers is an error (#39), Transfer-Encoding final-coding/TE+CL/HTTP-1.0 rules (#40), obs-fold and whitespace-before-colon (#41). RFC 9112 sections 2.2, 5.1, 5.2, 6.1, 6.3.
Three independent module bugs in one PR: FileDownloader deletes on non-206 (#50), OAuth refresh keeps the old refresh_token (#53), Retry-After capped by MaxDelay (#54).
Allocate stream ids inside _writeLock right before HEADERS (#13); frame writes use the connection token once a frame starts, header+payload as one write, fail the connection on a partial write (#14).

Expect: 100-continue early final response must not return the connection to the pool when the declared body was not sent (#37); flip RawSocketTransport_ExpectContinue_KeepAliveRejectionWithBody_ReusesConnectionAfterDrain. Part of #109 (plan doc fix stays out of this lane).
WebSocket: event-only consumers must not stall on the bounded pull queue (#78); a cancelled send mid-message aborts the connection instead of leaving partial framing (#79).
